name: revoking twice is a no-op with one audit record
disabled profile with valid consent -> profile_disabled
purge then synthesize -> profile_purged; files gone, hashes kept
render, revoke, deliver -> delivery refused consent_revoked
render then deliver -> succeeded, receipt and manifest written
consent audio identical to an enrollment sample -> reused_enrollment_audio
second draft while a consent is effective -> error, no row
refusal persisted as an utterance row
history: older rejected + newer revoked -> consent_revoked
history: older revoked + newer expired -> consent_expired
enroll 2xS + 1x S's sibling -> incoherent_enrollment, rolled back
draft, drop below the FR-3 minimum, grant -> not_enrolled
deliver then purge: delivered copies erased, receipts de-pathed
enrollment revert does not resurrect the superseded consent
